## What changes?

## Effect Boundary / security impact
- [ ] No effect semantics changed.
- [ ] Effect semantics changed and fail-closed/adversarial tests are included.
- [ ] Authority, evidence, retry, capability or release/security behavior changed and the relevant threat boundary is documented.

## Public truth
- [ ] No new certification/compliance/external-adoption claim is introduced without external evidence.
- [ ] Licensing/SPDX metadata remains correct.
- [ ] User-facing docs/examples match the implementation.

## Qualification
- [ ] `npm run qualify`
- [ ] `npm run benchmark:release` when performance/release behavior changes

By contributing, I certify the DCO sign-off requirements described in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
